name: iron-rules
description: House rules on shell calls, each off until you turn it on in /config: bun instead of npm, your git commit identity, no AI attribution in commits and PRs. Always blocks nested Windows shell deletes, whose quoting breaks.

gitName.title: Git author name
gitName.description: Added to every git commit, merge and rebase. Leave empty to keep git's own config.

gitEmail.title: Git author email
gitEmail.description: Used with the name above, e.g. your GitHub noreply address. Both must be set.

useBun.title: Rewrite npm/npx to bun/bunx
useBun.description: Rewrites npm/npx commands to bun/bunx before they run.

noAttribution.title: Strip AI attribution from commits and PRs
noAttribution.description: Removes Co-Authored-By Claude and "Generated with Claude Code" lines from commit and PR text.
